scope: Annotation preview, region gestures, save feedback and draft recovery
environment: Codex in-app browser; isolated Workspace and generated one-page PDF
browserChecks: Triangle preview uses a closed SVG path, circle preview uses an ellipse
Simulated ENOSPC before commit leaves body and region draft intact
Reload restores unsaved triangle, body and region; retry commits once
Editing a saved triangle changes its body and keeps the annotation count
Circle and triangle retain their distinct shapes after reload
Filled dot is visible at a single-click location
Both toolbar save and note-panel save persist the note body
Single-click with rectangle selected creates no tiny target and leaves save disabled
Final reload retains all three saved test annotations
limitations: Unsubmitted drafts live in sessionStorage; closing the browser session may discard them
Cross-page selection and ambiguous native PDF text anchoring retain their existing limitations
